info.title: Nimiq Mini Apps API
info.description:
REST API for the [Nimiq Mini Apps](https://nimiqminiapps.com) community directory.

**Submitting an app** — `POST /api/apps/submit` (wallet login required). Rate limit: **5 requests per hour per IP**.
Required field `submitter_contact` (Telegram, email, etc.) is stored privately and omitted from public responses.

**Open in Nimiq Pay** — listed apps expose `open_url` as `https://nimpay.app/miniapps/open/{domain}` (domain without `https://`).

Machine-readable spec: `GET /openapi.json` or `GET /openapi.yaml`.

tags.name: Submit
tags.description: Developer submissions (wallet login required for submit and update requests)

200.description: App list, or paginated result when `paginate=1`

post.summary: Submit a new app for review
post.description:
Creates an app with `status=submitted` and `featured=false`. Requires a wallet
session (see `POST /api/auth/verify`); the caller must have a `display_name` set
on their profile first. `developer_slug`/`developer_name` are derived from the
caller's wallet identity, not taken from the request body.
Rate limited to 5 submissions per hour per client IP (HTTP 429).

200.description: App details (submitted/rejected apps return 404 unless queried via admin)
Review status for a submitted or listed app

post.summary: Track an open or view event (public beacon)
post.description:
Fire-and-forget engagement counter. No auth. Rate limited to 20 requests/minute per IP+slug.
Unknown slugs and malformed bodies return 204 (no user-facing error).

post.summary: Record a privacy-minimal product analytics event
post.description:
Fire-and-forget catalog funnel tracking. Accepts only a strict event enum,
opaque browser/session identifiers (UUID-shaped, max 64 chars), and an
`app_slug` for app-scoped events. Identifiers are HMAC'd server-side before
persistence; raw values, IPs, user-agents, referrers, and wallet addresses
are never stored from this endpoint.

`wallet_login` is rejected here — it is recorded only by successful
`POST /api/auth/verify`. Rate limited (~120/minute per IP+visitor).
Requires `ANALYTICS_HASH_SECRET` on the server.

post.summary: Verify a signed wallet login challenge
post.description:
Verifies the signed challenge and sets the wallet session cookie.
Optional `analytics_visitor_id` / `analytics_session_id` let the server
record a `wallet_login` analytics event after successful verification
without accepting a client-supplied wallet hash.

get.summary: Daily open/view stats for an app (owner or admin)

200.description: Totals and last-30-days daily series (missing days omitted)

403.description: Wallet session is not an owner or admin

post.summary: Request a listing update (reviewed by admins)
post.description:
Proposes changes to an existing public listing. Requires a wallet session for one
of the app's current owners (see `owner_wallet_addresses`). `developer_name`/`developer_slug` in the
request body are ignored — identity changes are admin-only. Rate limited (same
5/hour per IP as submit). Only one pending revision per app at a time.

403.description: The wallet session does not own this app

409.description: A pending update already exists for this app

get.summary: Product analytics aggregates for fixed ranges
get.description:
Returns summary metrics, optional previous-period comparison (omitted for
`all`), daily series, unique-visitor funnel, and per-app rows. Values are
aggregates only — no raw visitor, session, or wallet identifiers.
Unique/funnel history begins when collection started (`collection_started_at`).

200.description: Aggregate analytics for the selected range
